body: Root cause: finishReason IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT for Rapunzel (Disney IP), misleadingly surfaced as generic 'no image data in response' which looked like a bad key. Fixed error surfacing + added skip-on-permanent-block to drainQueue so it can't jam the queue. Live-verified: re-drain correctly skipped 2 more Rapunzel items then stopped cleanly on a real 429. 3 new tests. Commit 4048b63.
title: Diagnosed + fixed 'broken tool' report: Vertex content-policy block, not auth failure
